hints.name: What the application is called. The banner and the browser tab both use it.
hints.slug: The address: /application/<slug>. Derived from the name until you edit it.
hints.tagline: One line under the banner. What this is, in a breath.
hints.summary: {{count}}/{{max}} · a short blurb for listings and link previews.
hints.featured: Pinned applications can be highlighted wherever the site lists them.
hints.banner: Wide artwork shown above the tab bar. It is never cropped, so any shape works.
hints.icon: Square mark, for cards and social previews.
hints.accent: Hex, like #A855F7. Tints the active tab and the version badges.
hints.version: Free text: 2.6.4, v3, 2026.1 or 1.0-beta all work. No spaces or slashes.
hints.released_at: The day this version shipped — not the day you wrote this up. It is what the tab sorts by.
hints.wiki_title: What the page is called in the sidebar.
hints.wiki_slug: The address inside the wiki. Derived from the title until you edit it.
hints.wiki_icon: An icon name the site resolves, like book-open. Not a URL.
hints.parent: Leave it at the top level, or hang this page under a section.
hints.parent_locked: This page has pages under it, so it cannot itself be nested.

list.title: Application pages
list.description: A product page for each application, all to the same shape: a banner, then the tabs you turn on.
list.search_placeholder: Search by name, slug or tagline
list.caption: Application pages
list.empty_description: Create one and it gets the house layout: a banner, a tab bar, and the tabs you choose behind it.
list.delete_body: “{{name}}” will be deleted, and so will every release note and wiki page it holds. This cannot be undone — archiving it instead hides the page without losing the text.

editor.description_new: A name is all it takes to start. Everything else can be filled in as you go.
editor.description_edit: The page itself. Its release notes and its wiki have screens of their own.
editor.identity_hint: What the application is called and where it answers.
editor.appearance_hint: The artwork and the accent. Everything else about the layout is the same on every page here, on purpose.
editor.tabs_hint: Which sections this page shows under its banner. Overview is always on.
editor.links_hint: The buttons under the banner: the repository, the stores, the community.
editor.overview_hint: One centred document. What this is, and why anyone would want it.
editor.contact_hint: How to reach support. The links above are repeated under it, so this is only the text.
editor.contact_placeholder: Open an issue, or find us on Discord.

status_hint.draft: Not visible on the site. Its releases and wiki are hidden with it.
status_hint.published: Live at its address, along with whichever of its tabs are published.
status_hint.archived: Taken down, but nothing is lost.

editor.publish_body: “{{name}}” will be readable by anyone at /application/{{slug}}.
editor.delete_body: “{{name}}” will be deleted, and so will every release note and wiki page it holds. This cannot be undone.
editor.translations_description: The fields above are the {{locale}} version. Anything left blank here falls back to it, so a partly translated page still renders.
editor.translations_none: This service publishes a single language, so there is nothing to translate.
editor.translations_source_empty: Nothing written above to translate yet.

links.empty: No links yet. The banner shows whatever you add here.
links.label: Label

updates.caption: Release notes
updates.empty_description: Each entry carries a version, the day it shipped, and links to wherever it can be downloaded.
updates.release_hint: The version, when it shipped, and what to call it.
updates.notes_hint: What changed. A short list beats a paragraph.
updates.body_placeholder:

- Fixed an issue where …
updates.links_hint: Where this particular version can be had: the GitHub release, the store listing, a direct download.
updates.version_invalid: A version cannot contain spaces or slashes — it is part of the address.

status_hint.draft: Not on the Updates tab yet.
status_hint.published: On the tab. Published without a date, it is dated now.
status_hint.archived: Taken off the tab, but kept.

updates.delete_body: The notes for {{version}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
